items.name: Banquet & designer chairs

faqs.q: Can I choose different chair colours for one event?
faqs.a: Yes. Many of our chair designs come in several frame and seat colours, so you can mix them — for example gold chairs for family and white for guests.

faqs.q: Do you arrange the furniture at the venue?
faqs.a: Yes. Our team delivers, places the tables and chairs to your seating plan, and collects everything after the event.

faqs.a: Yes. Everything is washed and checked before it leaves our store, and we count items with you at delivery and pick-up.

faqs.a: Yes. Tell us your guest count and menu style (buffet or served) and we'll suggest the right quantities.

name: Tents & Roofing
heroTitle: Tents & Pandals on Rent in Hyderabad
promise: Waterproof German hangers, pagodas, pandals and shamiyanas for any size of outdoor event.
summary: German hanger tents, pagodas, pipe pandals, shamiyanas and gazebos.
description: Rain or shine, we cover your guests. Choose a large clear-span German hanger hall, an elegant pagoda for the entrance, or a traditional pandal and shamiyana — set up by our own crew.

items.name: German hanger (super structure)
items.text: Large waterproof aluminium halls with no centre poles — a banquet hall anywhere.

items.name: Pagoda tents
items.text: Peaked tents for entrances, food counters, lounges and stalls.

items.name: Pipe pandals
items.text: Classic pandals with a waterproof roof option, decorated with drapes.

items.name: Shamiyana

items.name: Gazebo tents
items.text: Quick canopy tents for small gatherings and outdoor counters.

faqs.q: Are the tents safe in rain?
faqs.a: Our German hanger and pagoda tents use waterproof, UV-stabilised and fire-retardant fabric. For pipe pandals, choose the waterproof roof option during the monsoon.
Small pagodas and gazebos go up in a few hours. Large German hanger halls and pandals usually need one to two days, depending on size — we plan this with you.
